svg.title: Two cross-sections of the wafer, one above the other. Before the step three thin dark pads, one on each metal plug, sit on a flat oxide. After it a thin hatched film of even thickness covers the tops and sides of the pads and the oxide between them.
svg.desc: Two cross-sections of the wafer, one above the other. Before the step three thin dark pads, one on each metal plug, sit on a flat oxide. After it a thin hatched film of even thickness covers the tops and sides of the pads and the oxide between them.
svg.text: A thin silicon nitride is deposited over the
local interconnect and the oxide between.
After: a thin nitride cap over the local interconnect
Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
